name: Shield Booster
description: Pushes 60 shield hit points back into the shield every four seconds, at a cost of 30 GJ a cycle. It runs only while the capacitor holds. Alďmar's field-repair division builds it for the hulls that hold the line, and the district's fitters name it first when a shield fit is discussed.

name: Shield Extender
description: Adds 280 shield hit points with no activation and no draw of its own, and it costs the hull seven metres of signature radius. Vantera builds it as station shielding adapted for hulls, and the catalogue lists it as the first purchase for a hull that means to hold its ground.

name: Armor Repairer
description: Welds 55 armor hit points back into the plating every five seconds while the capacitor holds, at a cost of 25 GJ a cycle. Alďmar built its field-repair line around this module, and every repair bay on the ring keeps it in stock.

name: Armor Plate
description: Adds 400 armor hit points in layered plating, with no activation and no draw of its own. Kumbřan Steelworks rolls it from the same plate as its hulls, and the combine sells it to every yard on the ring.

name: Resist Coat
description: Hardens every layer against all four damage types by 15% each, with no activation and no draw of its own. Preštor lists it among the protective systems it sells to the patrol yards, and the coat is applied before a hull takes its first contract.
